dialogues.speaker: Nameless Tablet (II)
dialogues.text: "Shirin, my daughter. My dearest daughter, who has not known joy even for a day..."

dialogues.speaker: Nameless Tablet (II)
dialogues.text: "Gurabad's rise and fall found their beginning and end in you. In innocence you have suffered, and madness became your refuge..."

dialogues.speaker: Nameless Tablet (II)
dialogues.text: "In innocence you have suffered, and your mind, shattered and wild, was ripped away by your kin to create slaves equally mutilated in thought..."

dialogues.speaker: Nameless Tablet (II)
dialogues.text: "In innocence you have suffered, and thus, none bore witness to the calamitous end of Gurabad more completely than you..."
